subject: Renewal & tiered commit uplift — AstraCart hosted API
messages:
From: Lina Martinez <lina@astracart.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-10-05T09:24:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal + commit increase request — hosted API

Hi Rachel,

Hope you’re well. We’re approaching our renewal window (12/01) and after the last quarter’s feature launch our hosted API consumption has jumped ~60% month-over-month. Attached is the usage export (CSV) showing the surge pattern and burst days.

We’d like to discuss a 12-month renewal with an increased monthly commit from 3.5M tokens to 5.6M tokens (initial uplift to 4.8M, stepping to 5.6M after month 3). Important asks from our side:
- Clear rate tiers and per-token price bands for the stepped ladder
- A soft-burst cushion for seasonal spikes (we expect short surges up to 20–25% above commit)
- A fallback plan if capacity or latency degrades during Black Friday-like events
- Confirmation on proration for partial-month changes, and billing timing

Can we schedule a call this week to align on commercials and get a draft amendment? I’ve also looped in our legal (legal@astracart.com) who will want contract language around data residency and SLA credits for latency breaches.

Thanks,
Lina Martinez
Head of Product Ops, AstraCart

Attachments: usage-report-oct2026.csv (CSV export, 18KB)
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference>
To: Lina Martinez <lina@astracart.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-10-05T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + commit increase request — hosted API

Hi Lina — thanks for the context and the usage export. Congrats on the successful launch — this is the kind of growth we expect and we have a few standard approaches that can keep your latency SLOs while optimizing unit economics.

Proposed next steps (high level):
1) Quick alignment call (30m) — confirm staging cadence and the step-up schedule
2) Draft a one-page amendment with: stepped monthly commit ladder (4.8M month 1–3; 5.6M month 4–12), per-token pricing for each band, soft-burst cushion (25% burst window) and an explicit soft-throttle policy that preserves baseline throughput with graceful degradation.
3) If AstraCart needs lower-latency SLAs for specific routes, we can include a latency SLA addendum with credit thresholds and an ops runbook for escalation.
4) Legal review & signature (we’ll prepare a DocuSign packet).

I’ve attached an initial draft amendment for internal review (astracart-commit-amendment-draft.pdf). Aditya/Ben/Kimberly — can you review pricing and ops language below and confirm if the proposed 10% stepped discount for committing to 12 months is doable? Also we should confirm whether AstraCart qualifies for our dedicated burst pool or stays fully hosted with a burst cushion.

Lina — are you available Friday 10/08 at 11am PT or Thursday 10/07 at 2pm PT for the call?

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: astracart-commit-amendment-draft.pdf (PDF, 42KB)
Related: HubSpot AST-43921
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-10-05T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + commit increase request — hosted API

Quick pricing/ops notes for the team:
- Pricing: baseline token price $0.0028/token at 3.5M commit. For 12-month commit at 5.6M we can offer a blended rate equivalent to a 10% reduction off list, staggered by band (month 1–3 at -6%, month 4–12 at -12%) to reflect ramp risk.
- Burst policy: propose a soft-burst cushion of 25% above commit for short windows (max 72 hours per quarter) with automated fair-rate gating after that. Explicitly call out prorated billing for sustained overage beyond cushion.
- SLA: include a latency credit clause (credits apply when 95th percentile > 200ms for 3 consecutive days). Ops to provide a runbook for fallback model variant (lower-cost quantized variant) to maintain availability during capacity events.
- Implementation: Ben — can you update billing system to support a staged ladder and a prorate helper for mid-cycle upgrades? Kimberly — CS should own the migration kickoff and model routing test plan.

I’ll draft the commercial paragraph for the amendment and a short ops appendix. Rachel — if you lock in the call, I’ll prepare redlines to the draft before DocuSign.

—Aditya
From: Lina Martinez <lina@astracart.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference>
Cc: AstraCart Legal <legal@astracart.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-10-06T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + commit increase request — hosted API

Thanks Rachel — Thursday 10/07 at 2pm PT works for me (I've accepted the calendar invite). A few quick points from legal/ops side so they’re on the agenda:
- Data residency: AstraCart requires EU and US data partitions for customer PII. We need an explicit statement of where logs/payloads are retained and an ops contact for access requests.
- SLA: we’ll ask for a 1% service credit per 24hr window when 95th percentile latency >200ms, up to a max of 10% per month.
- Initial uplift: AstraCart will proceed with the proposed initial uplift to 4.8M for the first 3 months (subject to final amendment).

Please include the draft amendment and pricing bands in the meeting materials. Looking forward to getting the mutual action plan in place so we can finalize before 12/01.

Best,
Lina
